description: HCP Terraform (TFC) REST client and run engine for workspace-per-deployment provisioning: get-or-adopt workspace, variable upsert, run create/poll with plan-approval pause, plan summaries, state outputs, and safe-delete. The team token lives in the password field of a ConnectionInfo labeled 'tf-cloud' (selected on the order form; any number of labeled connections is supported); account-level non-secret config lives in the block at the top of the script.
label: HCP Terraform API
name: tfc_api
